description: Track the docker images pinned in shell scripts (issue #327).
No built-in manager reads shell scripts, so pins like
ACTIONLINT_IMAGE="${ACTIONLINT_IMAGE:-rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12}"
would rot while everything else auto-updates. The
'# renovate: datasource=docker' comment on the line above is what
this matches; scripts/lint-workflows.sh fails the build if a pin
is missing one, so a new pin cannot silently escape this manager.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once CI passes

description: Below 1.0.0 a minor bump is a BREAKING change under both cargo and
npm convention, but Renovate still types it 'minor', so the rule
above would auto-merge it. Two such bumps landed as PRs that could
not build at all (axum 0.7->0.8 rejected the ':param' route syntax,
reqwest 0.12->0.13 renamed the rustls-tls feature; both fixed in
#519), and tower-http 0.6->0.7 auto-merged in #493 purely because
CI happened to stay green. CI is the backstop for the first kind;
nothing catches a silent behavioural change, which is what this
rule is for.
Placement matters: Renovate applies packageRules in order and later
matches win, so this MUST stay after the auto-merge rule it
narrows. Patch bumps on 0.x (0.8.8 -> 0.8.9) keep auto-merging --
only the 0.x -> 0.y shape is held.
Measured over the repo's whole history before adding this: 6 of 37
version changes in api/Cargo.toml and 1 of 33 in ui/package.json
would have been held, so this is a handful of reviews, not a queue.
